title: Early failure detection and scenario-driven continuous delivery
context: The owner requests a durable scaffold for reliable, controllable and verifiable AI-led product delivery, early error detection and course correction without unnecessary limits on implementation ability.
decision: Extend the existing local task and verification system with focused task plans, selected fast checks, decision-bound evidence, accepted-history review, product scenarios and evidence-backed feedback. Derive readiness from observed checks and preserve explicit native and release gates.
authority: The owner explicitly authorizes auditing and implementing the long-term delivery scaffold. Product languages, runtime permissions, process boundaries and wire protocols are unchanged.

alternatives.option: Add more prose rules and skills without executable checks
alternatives.reason: Duplicated instructions do not expose stale evidence or provide a repeatable correction loop.

alternatives.option: Introduce a remote workflow platform and speculative runtime infrastructure
alternatives.reason: The current workflow fits repository-local records and commands; no external coordination need has been demonstrated.

consequences: Active tasks have a bounded observable outcome, risks with checks, relevant context and recovery direction.
Fast or selected checks expose omitted gates explicitly and cannot establish whole-product readiness.
Tooling checks retain partial output and terminate timed-out process groups; native Windows behavior still requires actual target execution.
Feedback resolution requires completed corrective work with matching checks; a deferred issue keeps its reason visible.
The history check compares with a Git base and cannot authenticate fabricated evidence or recover never-committed history.
Routine implementation remains autonomous; preserve the existing decision triggers and avoid mechanical approvals or tests for trivial edits.
Scenario definitions organize acceptance but do not demonstrate behavior until their checks actually execute.
revisit_when: Actual concurrent delivery exceeds repository-local coordination.
Product reviews or escaped defects reveal missing scenarios.
A repeatable multi-step procedure justifies extracting a skill.
